quote: we will not deploy the model until we have identified and implemented additional safeguards as appropriate
ruling: 1: trigger is the required response failing ('our Risk Mitigations are unable to appropriately control', p.6) and the consequence is a binding halt, 'will not deploy ... until' (C6a, E4). 'As appropriate' sits inside the until-clause and qualifies which safeguards end the halt, not the not-deploy action, so A4 does not void it. Same reading as 2025.02.

ruling: 1: p.5 senior leadership 'approve the mitigations prior to deployment'; the same bullet defines its recipients as the SVP for the model team, the CSO and legal counsel, so the label is defined as specific roles (C4). Approval is a formal part.

quote: Safety and Security Measures are unable to appropriately mitigate the risks (e.g., by preventing reliable elicitation of the capability by malicious actors), we will not deploy the model until we have identified and implemented appropriate additional safeguards.
ruling: 1: required Safety and Security Measures failing triggers a binding halt until additional safeguards are in place (C6a, E4). 'Appropriate' is an adjective on safeguards, not a qualifier on the action.
